_help: Pool of one-line idea / direction / technique candidates. The user rates Y/N on /ideas.html; ratings.json captures the verdict. Mutation worker can bias toward Y-rated ideas in directive sampling. Each idea may link to related project codes (pieces) — usually the parent piece or a sibling demonstrating the idea. id is stable; do not renumber.

ideas.text: brushstroke made manifest — as particles trace curves, pressure darkens (curvature bends the line), producing ink-on-paper immediacy from mathematical flow
forgotten alphabets emerge from dust — individual characters aggregated as billboards reveal legible script at distance; meaning dissolves into geometry up close
living vessels breathing — tapering capillary extremities pulse in synchronized throbs as if blood flows through crystalline architecture, simultaneous pulse and stillness
molten ribbon ascending — Persian geometry unfurling in gold seams, a single sinuous form that reads as tapestry from afar, pure mathematical constraint up close
transformation without rupture — organic capillaries harden into columnar stone, life becomes architecture, the threshold moment suspended between states
two silhouettes face inward, their negative space interlocks — together they form the complete figure neither could be alone
thermal bloom — particles erupt in heat-graded strata from coral floor, arcing upward and cooling as they rise, a thermal plume frozen in slow-motion
real presence — a Lucian head, cathedral nave, or fragmentary scan translated into 50k+ particles, the digital ghost of once-solid form
accretion without design — particles age and drift upward, crowding each other, forming stalagmite towers as if time and gravity conspired
invisible gravity well — the mathematics becomes flesh, particles trace an eternal orbit around an attractor that exists nowhere but everywhere
branching toward sky — stochastic wood grain, each twig reaches upward with organic hesitation, tufted crowns dense as canopy
sound made visible in rings — each frequency band rings its own shell, bass booms in wide arcs, treble trembles in tight oscillations, a seismic diagram of song
light made material — a volumetric blade cuts through mist; particles caught in the beam glow as if backlit by unseen suns
metamorphosis by touch — the same particle field transforms through multiple equations, each state a different creature wearing the same skin
weaving instead of stippling — particles connect as threads; the form emerges from line-weight and crossing, not scattered dots
color stratified like geology — translucent veils accumulate in depth, each layer shifts the perceived color of those behind, building luminous atmosphere
algorithmic bloom — 200k+ particles drift in mesmerizing flow, pearlescent shimmer between cyan and violet, data made dreamlike
systems that birth form — rule-based grids collapse into near-monochrome fields with one accent color, radical restraint
structured drift through earth — flow fields guide particles with invisible hand, composition feels hand-carved in terracotta and rust
color as solid matter — geometric blocks stack without gradation, pure hues meeting at clean edges, noise is banished
slow becoming — physics unfolds with hypnotic patience, each frame suggests vast time, oceanic palette recedes into depth
red thread through space — lines connect invisible anchors, webs suspended between unknown points, red and white in tense balance
light breathing in planes — color-field volumes stratified like sky at horizon, inhabitable light that surrounds and contains the viewer
slime-mold paths — particles follow pheromone logic, organic networks emerge without blueprint, intelligence from collective drift
code rendered as poetry — ASCII becomes 3D sculpture, the interface between logic and dream, future-interface materialized
deep time made visible — trajectories measured in geological pace, particles move like continents, indifferent to human watching
form in hiding — the piece never fully reveals itself, wrapped in fog and occlusion, receding into shy zones that resist complete comprehension
scale that dwarfs — the viewer becomes insignificant dot in vast field, overwhelming presence that humbles rather than seduces
forest-floor logic — composition obeys non-human agency (mycorrhizal networks, ant colonies, fungi), human meaning-making becomes irrelevant
beauty in breaking — JPEG artifacts, channel separation, the seams where the system fractures become the art itself
shared dreaming — multiple viewers' inputs weave together through WebSocket, each piece shaped by invisible audience presence
meditation enforced — rewards only patient attention, refuses to perform for the scanning eye, each frame holds wisdom
narrative through motion — each act introduces a new word, recontextualizing the particle field, one piece staged as theater in time
live witness — weather patterns, ISS position, real-time audio feed the form, making the piece a living measurement of the world
controls exposed — sliders let viewers sculpt the piece in real time, democracy of form-making
imperfection as choice — hand-drawn wobble, asymmetry, off-grid snap, handmade warmth over machine perfection
scuff the perfection — introduce 3-4 intentional breaks in the pattern, composition acquires character through imperfection
broken made precious — golden seams repair ruptures, the damage becomes the structure, wounds become beauty
songlines in dots — rhythmic dot accumulations map ancestral memory onto present space, dotting as meditation and map-making fused
sound made shape — particles dance to public-domain scores or live microphone input, the piece becomes a instrument visualizing vibration
skyward only — every form reaches upward without sprawl, a universe of vertical yearning
temperature contrast — warm against cool, nothing in between, pure complementary tension with additive glow in the midtones
